simulator.challenger_cards.quoted_text: Challenger cards are available to a player trailing by 6 or more victory points at the start of a battle round. simulator.challenger_cards.trigger: at the start of a battle round (rounds 2-5), the side whose victory-point total trails the opponent's by 6 or more victory points draws one extra challenger scoring card for that round. By default the gap is measured on the uncapped running totals. SWEG_CHALLENGER_GAP_CAPPED (default-OFF, HELD) switches it to the capped standing (primary <=50, secondary <=40, challenger <= lifetime cap — the totals that decide the winner) via _capped_vp_pair, which is the more faithful reading (real victory points are capped as scored) but screened metric-negative (N=40 vs sc22a, gated +0.11; Astra Militarum -1.91, Adeptus Astartes -1.77 — the uncapped gap was giving trailing under-poles extra catch-up draws). Held pending a verbatim challenger-card citation.
simulator.challenger_cards.effect: the trailing side draws ONE extra scoring card (an existing Tactical / take-and-hold objective) that round and scores it through the SAME achievement machinery the simulator already uses for Tactical secondaries (Battle._score_one_card); an army that cannot physically achieve the drawn objective scores 0 from it. Lifetime challenger contribution per side is capped at about 12 victory points. Implemented in Battle._run_round (round-start eligibility + deterministic draw) and Battle._score_secondaries (end-of-round achievement scoring via the existing card scorer). Env-gated SWEG_CHALLENGER_CARDS; default OFF is byte-identical (no extra draw, no victory points, no RNG consumed). Even-handed: EITHER side draws when it is the one trailing by 6+, by the identical rule, with no per-faction branch.
